text: Artificial intelligence is rapidly changing the modern workplace. One of its biggest impacts is automation, where machines handle repetitive tasks like data entry or scheduling. This allows employees to focus on more creative and complex work. At the same time, productivity tools powered by AI help workers analyze large amounts of information quickly, write better emails, and manage projects more efficiently. However, this does not mean humans are being replaced. Instead, human-AI collaboration is key, with people supervising and making final decisions. While some jobs will disappear, many new roles will appear. Workers will need to learn new skills, but the future promises a more efficient and satisfying work environment.
